title: Fog Over the Bay
words: fog bay san francisco night calm lighthouse golden gate moon cozy
style: soft painterly gouache storybook illustration, calm and cozy, smooth brushy gradients, rounded simple shapes, moonlit teal and deep navy with warm lamplight accents

frame.scene: San Francisco Bay at night seen from the water: a calm deep teal bay filling the lower two thirds, the red Golden Gate Bridge small and hazy on the far left horizon, a tiny lighthouse with a warm lamp on a rock at the right edge, a pale full moon high in a navy sky
frame.focal: a cute soft white fog cloud with a sleepy smile drifting over the water, with a few tiny twinkling light glints on the water around it
frame.hud: one small blank frosted rounded plaque at the top

backdrop.scene: seen from higher above the water: the far shore, the red Golden Gate Bridge on the left, the lighthouse on its rock on the right and the full moon all sit in a thin band of night sky at the very top, with the horizon only 18% down from the top edge; calm moonlit teal water fills everything below the horizon, down to the bottom edge, with no fog cloud and no glints
backdrop.calm: the water from 20% of the height down to the bottom is smooth and calm with only soft gentle ripples and a faint moonlight path

items.text: a cute soft fluffy white fog cloud with a sleepy closed-eye smile, wide and puffy, pale blue shading underneath
a single twinkling moonlight glint on water: a small bright four-pointed pale gold star sparkle over a tiny teal ripple ring
a small wisp of soft white fog, a little trailing puff with no face
a small cozy lighthouse lamp room glowing warm yellow with a red roof, as a round badge emblem

ui.material: frosted sea glass: a soft translucent pale teal face with a thin warm brass rim and rounded corners

wordmark.lettering: hand-painted gouache storybook title lettering, soft serif letters in warm lamplight cream with a deep navy outline and a faint teal glow
